title: Prepare attributable controlled transition accounts
statement: The MOD-006 responsibility shall prepare attributable controlled transition accounts within the exact selected scope, preserving original meaning and explicit incomplete outcomes.

what.problem: Transition meaning and participant-assisted recording cooperation can otherwise conflate preparation with confirmed effects or hide unavailable content.

why.rationale: SR-023 requires this accountable architectural contribution; other contributions retain their own owners.

conditions: A participant requests transition meaning and participant-assisted recording cooperation.

contexts: The selected local project state and declared retained/current material under state-control.md.

how.approach: Apply state-control.md with exact identity/scope and original interpretation, explicit custody/authority boundaries and attributable incomplete or confirmed outcomes.

how_much.scope: Transition meaning and participant-assisted recording cooperation. No full IR003 assessment, runtime qualification, destructive adoption or operational maintenance execution is claimed.

acceptance_criteria: Identify Change/project, initiating basis, affected subjects/revisions, actors, decisions, exact originating/resulting baselines and adopted outcome for an established transition.
Keep proposal, observed execution, accountable decision and confirmed retention separate; missing baseline, decision or execution context remains an incomplete transition.
Carry actual prepared content through explicit supported recording; storage success grants neither authority nor semantic approval and uncertain effects require scoped readback.
Preserve significant historical decisions and completion meaning through explicit attributable corrections; routine updates need not retain every former version.
Keep transition provenance inspectable independently of current definitions, while current-model reading requires no Change replay; unavailable history remains unavailable rather than no Change.
Permit a compact completed operational acceptance account without logging every action/check, preserving original baseline meaning and still-relied-on support.
constraints: Proposed Design; no implementation, executed criterion verification or satisfaction claim.

sources.basis: Define immutable baseline custody, original-meaning comparison/recovery, attributable transition preparation and dependency-safe retirement. Preserve selective retention and separate action authority, operational maintenance and actual execution; proposed Design only.
